title: The 4 Best String Trimmers Under $100
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for string trimmers under $100, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at string trimmers under $100 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Greenworks 40V 12-Inch Cordless String Trimmer
products.blurb: Key specs: 12-inch cutting swath, 40V lithium battery, 2.0Ah included, Dual line auto-feed.
strengths: Battery and charger included at a price that competitors often charge for the bare tool alone
3-year warranty is longer than most trimmers at this price point
Handles typical small to medium yard trimming without issue
limitations: 12-inch swath is on the narrower side
2.0Ah battery runtime is modest on larger lots
Plastic shaft coupler feels less premium than pricier models
features: Typically $80 to $100 with battery and charger

products.name: Worx WG183 40V String Trimmer
products.blurb: Key specs: 13-inch dual-exit cutting head, 40V PowerShare, 2 x 2.0Ah batteries included, Under 5 pounds.
strengths: Lightest trimmer in this price range
Pivoting head adds edging capability most budget trimmers skip
limitations: 13-inch swath, still on the narrower end
PowerShare batteries don't cross over to non-Worx tools

products.name: Husqvarna 128LD Gas String Trimmer
products.blurb: Key specs: 28cc 2-cycle gas engine, 17-inch cutting swath, Straight shaft.
strengths: More cutting power than any battery trimmer at a similar price point
No battery to buy or replace down the road
17-inch swath covers ground faster than the 12 to 13-inch battery models here
limitations: Ongoing fuel and oil cost adds to the real total price over time
Heavier and louder than the cordless options in this list
features: Street price often close to or just above $100 depending on retailer

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
